text:
FF7 Remake Director Wants Physical Games to Continue - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
FF7 Remake Trilogy director Naoki Hamaguchi isn't a fan of Sony's decision to stop supporting physical PS5 discs. Speaking at FF14 Fan Fest, Hamaguchi said it would be, quote, "a real shame for that culture to disappear," referring to physical media in games. He also said he's pushed for a physical release of the upcoming Final Fantasy 7: Revelations, but Square Enix has not made a final decision yet. In other news, Xbox Game Pass games for August have been announced, and the trial for Gears of War: E-Day leads the pack. And finally, Amazon and Dave Bautista are reportedly in talks for the star to replace Ryan Hurst in the Gears of War live-action series. Hurst was injured earlier this year on set, and recovery will apparently take too long for them to wrap production on time (not to mention, child co-star Callum Vinson, who may age out of the role during Hurst's recovery).

The X-Files: I Want to Believe - Vrach Frankenshteyn - Official Trailer (2026)
Don't miss the Official Trailer for The X-Files: I Want to Believe - Vrach Frankenshteyn, a film in the X-Files universe distributed by Disney+ and Hulu. Witness the director's cut with The X-Files: I Want to Believe - Vrach Frankenshteyn, premiering on August 14 on Disney+ and Hulu.

When a group of women is mysteriously abducted, it becomes a case right out of The X-Files. Years after walking away from the FBI, Fox Mulder and Dr. Dana Scully are pulled back from the shadows when a federal agent vanishes without a trace. In a case you’d never see on TV, their only lead is a disgraced, defrocked priest claiming to have horrific psychic visions of the crime. Forced to confront the ghosts of their past, the partners must navigate a chilling winter landscape and an even darker human monstrosity. The truth of these crimes is out there somewhere … and it will take Mulder and Scully to find it.

The X-Files: I Want to Believe - Vrach Frankenshteyn stars David Duchovny and Gillian Anderson.

The X-Files: I Want to Believe - Vrach Frankenshteyn is premiering on August 14 on Disney+ and Hulu.

Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
Salieri isn't here to play games. Join design director Josh Zammit from developer Hangar 13 for a deep dive into the gameplay features and items of the Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor expansion for the action-adventure game. Learn about the story and more from the Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor expansion, where you will continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore. 

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor will be available on PlayStation 5 (SP5), Xbox Series X/S, and Steam on August 14, 2026.

text:
Violent Night 2 - Official Trailer (2026) David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell
Merry Christmas to all, and to all a good fight. Check out the Violent Night 2 trailer for this upcoming movie with David Harbour reprising his role as Santa Claus. The sequel also stars Jared Harris, Kristen Bell, Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2). 

If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. 

In 2022’s bare-knuckle holiday sensation, Violent Night, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall. 

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Violent Night 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film’s returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures. 

Violent Night 2 opens in theaters December 4, 2026.

Beast of Reincarnation - Everything You Need to Know About Cooking
The world may have fallen victim to the blight in Beast of Reincarnation, but there’s no reason Emma and Koo should have to go without a good meal! 
In Beast of Reincarnation, cooking is your key to survival because it keeps you from going hungry and buffs your stats. The game treats food as a way to buff your stats and restore your health - sort of...  It’s a bit of a beast itself, and it’s not immediately clear how it works, but its effects on your strength are huge. If you're struggling to understand how cooking works in Beast of Reincarnation, this ultimate guide will teach you everything you need to know!
